Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BBQR- DUAL ENERGY (PNEUMATIC AND ULTRASOUND ) INTRACOR PORAL LITHOTRIPSY MACHINE 1. The Duel Energy (Pneumatic and Ultrasound) Intracorporal Lithotripsy M achine should have a technology to simultaneously produce, at the probe t ip, a constant ultrasonic wave energy and intermittent shockwave (Pneum atic/ Mechanical) for stone fragmentation. 2. The machine should be able to deliver: a. Pneumatic energy – with a maximum frequency of 12 Hz or more for fas t coarse fragmentation. b. Ultrasonic energy- with single pulse frequency of 21-26 Khz or more for f ine fragmentation and pulverization. c. Simultaneous use of both energies for multiplied action. 3. Should have separate hand pieces and probes for ballistic and ultrasoun d devices, when they are being used separately. 4. Should also have facility to integrate both probes when using both the e nergies simultaneously. 5. Pneumatic hand piece should be light in weight with good ergonomics f or better control. It should have a reduced probe displacement for greater fragmentation control. The probe should be water tight to prevent moistur e entering inside. 6. Facility to integrate the pneumatic hand piece to the suction equipment should be provided.

7. Ultrasound hand piece should be water tight and allow for faster stone c learance by transportation through dedicated suction connectors. It should be light weight and ergonomically designed, ultrasound probes should hav e hole in the distal tip to prevent mucosal suction into the probe. 8. Should be able to fragment and aspirate all stone sizes, shapes and com positions at a fast speed. 9. Medical grade compressor should be supplied along with the equipment which should be able to withstand pressures from 3.5 to 5 Bar. 10. The machine should be able to deliver energies at variable settings which should be adjustable and should be provided with the display. 11. Should have facility to connect the unit to hospital’s compressed air su pply. 12. Should be supplied with a dual pedal footswitch to operate either one energy or both energy sources. 13. Should be compatible for gas, glutaraldehyde sterilization and for auto claving. 14. Precisely adjustable suction pump for all suction requirements of lithotr ipsy procedures to the supplied along with, from the same OEM. 15. Facility to collect the stone fragments, should be integrated with the su ction. 16. System should be USFDA/European CE certified /BIS. 17. Should have ‘’satisfactory working’’ report from the user from reputed Government institutions in India where same model, as quoted in the curr ent tender, is supplied. Bidders to attach other copies with installation rep ort & latest performance certificates issued by the users. 18.
